messages:
Aisha: Heads-up 0ms: Prospect 'Velocity Commerce' asked for a short smoke + throughput bench next Tue. Goal: 800 qps sustained, p99 < 150ms, mixed payloads (mostly 64 tokens, occasional 400). They also submitted a security questionnaire asking about VPC peering and KMS. Can we scope a plan + estimate?

Tom: SE: We can do this on a small Dedicated cluster. Need to confirm model (they suggested rdx-13b). Also ask if embeddings are used (affects qps). Propose: 3x 5m steady runs after a 5m prewarm, plus one 20m soak if they want.

Ravi: SRE: Node estimate for rdx-13b at 800 qps worst-case ~4 A100-equivalents with aggressive KV caching. Will create reservation and prewarm script. Note: VPC peering works, but peering setup usually takes 2460h depending on their infra team.

Nina: Security: We support customer-managed KMS and can provide SOC2 summary. HSM attestation is possible for Private but needs legal intake. I'll draft questionnaire answers and attach them.

Aisha: Can someone paste the vegeta command we'll use and a simple schedule that I can send to the buyer?

Tom: vegeta example:
```
vegeta attack -targets=vel.targets.txt -rate=800 -connections=200 -duration=5m | vegeta report -type=json
```
Schedule: Prewarm 5m (0->800 qps), 3x 5m steady runs, optional 20m soak. Deliverables: latency histograms, GPU utilization, KV hit ratio, run artifacts.

deploy-bot: cluster-reservation #R-3310 created by Ravi (expires 48h)

Ravi: Reservation done. I'll post node counts and the prewarm script by EOD.

[Post-run] Tom: Run complete. Results summary: three steady runs at 800 qps. p50 22ms, p95 75ms, p99 140ms. Error rate 0.05% (retries). KV hit ~42%. Full artifacts uploaded to the shared runbook.

Aisha: Great. I'll send results + a bench cost estimate (one-off bench $2k) and next steps for a Dedicated trial. Thanks team :party:
